summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.08/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.08 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 11, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 2¢ lower than a week ago, 10¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.42 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.87) and the highest in Superior ($4.46).
